2025 processing-fee revenue: Tidewick earned €93,583 in payment-processing fees on €3.97M of merchant payment volume, growing to a €14.3k December peak — full platform-fee revenue isn't in this data yet, to follow.

Merchant concentration: our top 10 merchants still drive ~65% of payment volume (led by Cragsley Outfitters at ~18%), but that share is edging down as the merchant base grows (92 → 113 active merchants year over year).

Refunds: Apparel merchants run a steady ~20% refund rate (normal for fashion), but a handful of smaller non-Apparel merchants (e.g. OfficeHub Nordic, Sports & Outdoor sellers) drove a refund-rate spike to ~13% company-wide in Q3 — still being double-checked against return records.
